rationale: Phase 09 fits the existing zero-backend architecture: no server code was added, the only package.json delta is dev-only (axe-core, fake-indexeddb in devDependencies) plus moving vite out of dependencies, all Phase-09 spec_atom nodes carry schema-v3.1.0 domains that match their spec files, quorum resolves a coherent 12-persona tiered set, and graph.mjs add-spec is idempotent (270 -> 270 nodes over two runs). One non-blocking robustness finding is recorded in evidence (spec-parse.mjs mis-parses SPEC-014's intentionally-empty "- Domains:" line as ["##","Goal"], which a future graph.mjs init would write as invalid domain values); the committed ledger is unaffected, so I approve with that one-line parser fix plus an empty-line unit case required before any re-init.
